faq.q: Can I use this SVG in Cricut Design Space?
faq.a: The tool creates standard single-color SVG output that you can test in Cricut Design Space. Always inspect sizing and cut behavior before using paid materials.

faq.q: Will this preserve the colors from my PNG?
faq.a: No. This page is built for single-color cut SVGs. It traces the image into one editable SVG color, which is better for vinyl, HTV, decals, stencils, labels, and silhouettes.

faq.q: Is this an official Cricut converter?
faq.a: No. iLoveSVG is independent and is not affiliated with Cricut. The page is tuned for common single-color Cricut-style cut workflows.

faq.q: What images work best?
faq.a: High-contrast logos, silhouettes, lettering, simple drawings, and clean PNG graphics usually work best. Busy photos often need manual cleanup after vectorization.

faq.q: Does transparent output remove the source background?
faq.a: Transparent background prevents the converter from adding a background rectangle. A backdrop already traced from your image remains part of the artwork. Clean up the source or adjust the trace and check the result before downloading.

faq.q: What file limits apply?
faq.a: PNG and JPEG files are accepted up to 30 MB and roughly 30 megapixels. Preview is fastest under 10 MB and throttled up to 25 MB.
